definitions.gloss: pen name; pseudonym; nom de plume
definitions.explanation: A fictitious name used by a writer instead of their real name.

examples.japanese: {筆名|ひつめい}で{活動|かつどう}する。
examples.english: To work under a pen name.

examples.japanese: その{作家|さっか}の{筆名|ひつめい}は{有名|ゆうめい}だが、{本名|ほんみょう}は{知|し}られていない。
examples.english: That author's pen name is famous, but their real name is unknown.

examples.japanese: {夏目|なつめ}{漱石|そうせき}は{筆名|ひつめい}であり、{本名|ほんみょう}は{夏目|なつめ}{金之助|きんのすけ}という。
examples.english: Natsume Soseki is a pen name; his real name was Natsume Kinnosuke.

notes:
A compound of {筆|ひつ} (writing brush; pen) and {名|めい} (name). Used specifically for writers and authors. In Japanese literary tradition, pen names have been used extensively, with many of Japan's most famous authors being known primarily by their {筆名|ひつめい}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {筆名|ひつめい}で{書|か}く: to write under a pen name
- {筆名|ひつめい}を{使|つか}う: to use a pen name
- {筆名|ひつめい}で{活動|かつどう}する: to be active under a pen name
- {筆名|ひつめい}と{本名|ほんみょう}: pen name and real name

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ペンネーム: pen name — the loanword from English, more casual and widely used in modern Japanese
- {雅号|がごう}: art name — a name used by artists, poets, and calligraphers, more traditional
- {芸名|げいめい}: stage name — used by entertainers and performers
- {匿名|とくめい}: anonymity — hiding one's identity entirely rather than using a substitute name
